response.overview: Dr. F. Otze lets an assistant off the hook for embezzling prescriptions—though this first requires a bit of bribery. Afterward, Otze uses Viagra and his assistant to help an impotent patient regain his potency. Dr. Otze’s colleague, Dr. Roberto, sets out on two house calls, during which he enters through the front door and immediately comes back in through the back door.
response.title: Dr. F. Otze 4

titles.title: Dr. F. Otze Teil 4: So wirkt Viagra auf Schlapp-Schwänze
